inputs.prompt: ONE original tall armoured warrior, the Gloamkeel Bulwark veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the blackened scale and plate armour, the tall narrow finned helmet with a pale streaked face guard, the long tattered dark navy cloak and tabard strips streaked with pale grey, the belted waist and the dark armoured boots. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-LEFT hand holds ONE curved single-edged saber; the screen-RIGHT arm carries ONE large black kite shield with dark bronze trim, an anchor emblem, an iron ring and a round glowing amber lantern porthole near its top. Preserve the saber, the shield with its lantern, the finned helmet and the tall proportions. A grim, watchful idle that loops. The warrior breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, the saber turns a little in the low hand, the shield settles on the arm, the helmet turns slightly to scan and the cloak strips stir, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame. Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full helmet, saber, shield, cloak, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs; the lantern keeps only its steady glow. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the shield stays rigid and never morphs.
